source.author: verg
source.text: Sic fatus, validis ingentem viribus hastam in latus inque feri curvam compagibus alvum contorsit: stetit illa tremens, uteroque recusso insonuere cavae gemitumque dedere cavernae.
source.text_original: Sic fatus, validis ingentem viribus hastam / in latus inque feri curvam compagibus alvum / contorsit: stetit illa tremens, uteroque recusso / insonuere cavae gemitumque dedere cavernae.
source.text_english: So speaking, with mighty strength he hurled his huge spear into the beast’s side and into its belly, arched with joints: there it stood quivering, the womb shaken, the hollow caves rang out and gave a groan.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sic fatus pingui cumulat libamine flammam.
reuse.text_original: ' / sic fatus pingui cumulat libamine flammam.
reuse.text_english: Having spoken thus, he heaps up the flame with rich libation.
